rows.name: Engraved walnut coasters
rows.made_from: American black walnut, 6 mm, cut and engraved on the laser.
rows.finished_with: Sanded to 240 grit, then two coats of Danish oil.
rows.care: Wipe with a damp cloth. Keep them out of the dishwasher.
rows.lettering_hint: Tell us the name and the date. We set it in the font shown in the photos — if you want something else, say so and we'll reply before we cut.

rows.name: Birch ply coasters
rows.made_from: Baltic birch ply, 3 mm, cut and engraved on the laser.
rows.finished_with: Sanded and left bare, or waxed if you ask.
rows.care: Wipe with a damp cloth. Keep them out of the dishwasher.
rows.lettering_hint: Tell us the name and the date. We set it in the font shown in the photos — if you want something else, say so and we'll reply before we cut.

rows.name: Slate house sign
rows.made_from: Welsh slate blanks, riven face, 5 mm.
rows.finished_with: Etched on the laser, lettering filled by hand and sealed.
rows.care: It lives outside quite happily. Wipe the face clean once a year.
rows.lettering_prompt: House name or number, up to 28 characters
rows.lettering_hint: Tell us exactly how you want it written, including any punctuation. We set it in the font shown in the photos — if you want something else, say so and we'll reply before we cut.

rows.name: Slate garden markers
rows.made_from: Slate offcuts from the sign blanks, 5 mm.
rows.finished_with: Etched on the laser and left raw.
rows.care: Rinse them off at the end of the season.
rows.lettering_prompt: One word per marker, up to 12 characters each
rows.lettering_hint: List what you'd like on each of the six — basil, thyme, and so on. We'll set them all the same way.

rows.name: Acrylic keyring
rows.made_from: Cast acrylic, 3 mm, with a split ring.
rows.finished_with: Flame-polished edges.
rows.care: It will scuff eventually. That is what keys do.
rows.lettering_hint: A name, a nickname, a date. We set it in the font shown in the photos.

rows.name: Engraved pet tag
rows.made_from: Cast acrylic, 3 mm, with a small split ring.
rows.finished_with: Engraved both sides, edges polished.
rows.care: Check the ring every few months.
rows.lettering_prompt: Name on the front, number on the back — up to 20 characters each
rows.lettering_hint: Give us the name and the number you want us to reach you on. We cut both sides in one pass.

rows.name: 3D-printed desk tray
rows.made_from: Matte PLA, printed at 0.2 mm on the small printers.
rows.finished_with: Base sanded flat, feet trimmed by hand.
rows.care: Keep it off a sunny windowsill — PLA softens in a hot car.

rows.name: 3D-printed herb pot
rows.made_from: Matte PLA, printed at 0.2 mm, with a saucer that prints with it.
rows.finished_with: Ribbed outside, sealed inside with two extra walls.
rows.care: For the windowsill, not the garden. Empty the saucer.

rows.name: Stoneware mug
rows.made_from: Stoneware clay, thrown by hand and fired twice.
rows.finished_with: Bisque fired, glazed, then fired again to 1240°C.
rows.care: Dishwasher and microwave are both fine.
rows.lettering_hint: We letter the mug by hand under the glaze, so the line stays soft at the edges. Tell us what it should say.

rows.name: Two-layer cake topper
rows.made_from: Cast acrylic, 3 mm, cut in two layers that sit slightly apart.
rows.finished_with: Edges flame-polished, spike glued and left overnight.
rows.care: Wash it and keep it — most people do.
rows.lettering_prompt: Two lines, up to 24 characters in total
rows.lettering_hint: Give us both lines and we'll cut them as one piece with a spike on the back.

rows.name: Walnut cutting board
rows.made_from: One board of American black walnut, 18 mm, edges rounded.
rows.finished_with: Sanded to 320 grit and oiled three times.
rows.care: Hand wash and re-oil it when it looks thirsty.
rows.lettering_hint: We engrave into the face, off to one corner so the middle stays flat for the knife.

rows.name: Wedding sign
rows.made_from: Baltic birch ply, 3 mm, cut and engraved on the laser.
rows.finished_with: Sanded, with a standing foot cut from the same sheet.
rows.care: Indoors only — ply and rain do not get on.
rows.lettering_prompt: Up to 40 characters across two lines
rows.lettering_hint: Names and the date, usually. Send us the wording exactly as you want it and we'll send a picture back before we cut.

rows.name: Walnut bookmark
rows.made_from: American black walnut, 6 mm, cut from the same boards as the coasters.
rows.finished_with: Sanded thin at the tip and oiled.
rows.care: Wipe it. That is all it asks.
rows.lettering_hint: A name or a short line. It runs down the length of the bookmark.

rows.name: Photo block
rows.made_from: Layers of birch ply pressed to a 20 mm block.
rows.finished_with: Engraved in greyscale, edges sanded round.
rows.care: Keep it out of direct sun so the engraving stays dark.
rows.lettering_prompt: One line under the picture, up to 30 characters
rows.lettering_hint: Send the picture and the line you want under it. We engrave the picture in greyscale, so high contrast works best.

rows.name: The Little Bookshop
rows.made_from: Birch ply, 3 mm, fourteen pieces cut on the laser.
rows.finished_with: Engraved, sanded, packed flat with a sheet of instructions.
rows.care: Dust it with a soft brush. Keep it out of damp rooms.
rows.lettering_prompt: The shop sign, up to 14 characters
rows.lettering_hint: Name the shop. You can put your own words or logo in the left window too.

rows.name: Name keyring
rows.made_from: Matte PLA, printed at 0.2 mm, with a split ring.
rows.finished_with: Edges cleaned by hand, letters raised 1 mm.
rows.care: Keep it out of a hot car — PLA softens at about 60°C.
rows.lettering_hint: Printed in PLA with the letters raised 1 mm.

rows.name: Keepsake box
rows.made_from: American black walnut, 6 mm, seven finger-jointed pieces cut on the laser.
rows.finished_with: Sanded to 240 grit and oiled. Sent flat with glue and a sheet of instructions, or glued and finished by us.
rows.care: Wipe it with a dry cloth. Keep it out of direct sun, which pales walnut over the years.
rows.lettering_hint: A name, a date, what it is for. Add your logo and it goes beside the words. We send a picture before we cut.

rows.name: Layered name sign
rows.made_from: Three layers of Baltic birch ply, 3 mm each: the back, the frame and the lettering, cut on the laser and glued up.
rows.finished_with: The lettering painted before it is glued, so the edges stay crisp. A keyhole slot on the back for one screw.
rows.care: Indoors only. Dust it with a soft brush.
rows.lettering_hint: Big script lettering, cut as its own layer and raised 3 mm. A small line underneath is up to you.

rows.name: Hexagonal name pot
rows.made_from: Matte PLA, printed at 0.2 mm, six flat sides and a drainage hole.
rows.finished_with: The name raised 1 mm on the front panel, printed in the same pass.
rows.care: For the windowsill, not the garden. Empty the saucer.
rows.lettering_hint: The herb, a name for it, or whose it is. Capitals print cleanest.

rows.name: Phone stand
rows.made_from: Matte PLA, printed at 0.2 mm. Holds a phone or a small tablet at 65°.
rows.finished_with: A name raised 1 mm along the front lip.
rows.care: Wipe it with a damp cloth. Keep it out of a hot car.
rows.lettering_prompt: Along the front, up to 12 characters
rows.lettering_hint: A name, a desk, a business — it reads along the front lip.

rows.name: Print-in-place fox
rows.made_from: Matte PLA, printed in one piece with every joint already moving — nothing to put together.
rows.finished_with: Every joint worked loose by hand and checked one by one.
rows.care: Not for under-threes: the tail joints are small.
